text: Acceptance evidence: exact multiset WL test distinguishes one vs parallel equal incidences and is enumeration-invariant; undirected loop changes round-1 colour and reifies to one endpoint; directed loop reifies Source+Target; graph4s fromEdgeList returns typed errors for loops and reversed parallel edges and preserves accepted values; hand reference plus randomized property certify deterministic alpha-invariant relation reification. Standard 43/43 and graph4s adapter 11/11 pass independently on JVM, JS, and Native. ADR-009 is Accepted and documents the policy.
